{"path":"/results/6_Nov_Optimised/gpt_4o/tool_calling/quenching/subtask_true/level_3/brief/sio2_quenching_3_subtask_quenching_trial_2/quench.in","content":"# LAMMPS Input Script for SiO2 NPT Quenching

units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read data file
read_data       /structures/melt/SiO2/melt.dat

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style      tersoff
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/TERSOFF/2007_SiO.tersoff Si O

# Define settings for NPT ensemble
variable        Tstart equal 5000
variable        Tstop equal 1500
variable        P equal 0.0
variable        rate equal 3.5

timestep        0.001

# Equilibrate at high temperature
fix             1 all npt temp ${Tstart} ${Tstart} $(100.0*dt) iso ${P} ${P} $(1000.0*dt)
run             10000

# Quenching process
unfix           1
fix             2 all npt temp ${Tstart} ${Tstop} $(100.0*dt) iso ${P} ${P} $(1000.0*dt)
run             100000

# Output
thermo          100
thermo_style    custom step temp press vol density
log             /results/6_Nov_Optimised/gpt_4o/tool_calling/quenching/subtask_true/level_3/brief/sio2_quenching_3_subtask_quenching_trial_2/log.lammps
"}
